parole.significato: An alcoholic beverage, especially an inferior or illicit one and especially liquor such as whisky.
parole.testo: Abbreviation of hoochinoo, name of a specific liquor, from Tlingit Xutsnoowú Ḵwáan, the group that produced it, from Hutsnuwu (“grizzly bear fort”), the name of the village on Admiralty Island in which they lived. From Tlingit xóots (“grizzly bear”).

parole.significato: A mythical part-otter, part-human shapeshifter, in Tlingit and Tsimshian folklore, sometimes represented as tricksters…
A First Nation people inhabiting northwest British Columbia, on the mouth of the Nass river.
parole.testo: From Tlingit Naasgha. (“people of the Nass river”).

parole.significato: A member of an Indian people from the coastal regions of Alaska and British Columbia.
